descriptions.text: Two months ago PancakeBunny got rekt on BSC, now the same thing has happened on Polygon. $2.4 million lost. How earitating.

DeFi revenue aggregator PancakeBunny tweeted that its version on Polygon was attacked by outsiders and has suspended all Polygon Sushi Vaults. According to officials, Polygon vaults, BSC PancakeBunny vaults, and BUNNY are currently safe. The attacker made a profit of 1281 WETH.

PancakeBunny's Polygon deployment was exploited on July 16, 2021, via a flash loan that manipulated LP token prices to mint excessive polyBUNNY rewards. The attacker extracted approximately $2.4 million, replicating a vulnerability previously exploited on BSC. The protocol's reward minting logic used spot AMM LP token prices as part of fee calculations. This price could be manipulated within a single transaction by adding and removing liquidity via flash loans, leading to inflated rewards. The flaw had been exploited before on BSC and was left unpatched in the Polygon deployment.

On 2021-07-16, PancakeBunny's Polygon deployment PolyBUNNY was exploited through manipulated reward accounting tied to SushiSwap liquidity positions. The attacker inflated the protocol's interest calculation, minted roughly 2.1 million polyBUNNY, and extracted about 1,281 ETH before exiting. Public reporting and the team's compensation plan described the impact as approximately $2.4 million. The available evidence indicates that PolyBUNNY reward minting trusted manipulable on-chain liquidity and interest calculations tied to SushiSwap positions.
